summary: Injected IDOR vulnerability bypassing owner scoping in get_link_by_id; student correctly identified the missing tenant ownership check in the database query.
evidence: Automated security isolation test failed: test_multi_tenant_isolation_and_idor_prevention returned HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 404.
Student accurately diagnosed that authentication succeeded but authorization failed because the query looked up only by link ID without verifying tenant ownership.
Student proposed filtering the query by both Link.id and authenticated principal_id, raising HTTP 404 if no match.
